description: Source code for a Python exception handling and reporting class, including exception handling, UI interaction, and file operations.

classes.name: ExceptionHandler
classes.description: Handles exceptions by saving tracebacks, providing UI options for debugging, saving, or quitting, and managing exception reports.

methods.name: _setExitCode
methods.description: Sets the exit code for the exception handler.

methods.name: handleException
methods.description: Main method to handle an exception: saves traceback, displays UI, and responds to user choices.

methods.name: preWriteHook
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to execute code before writing traceback to disk.

methods.name: postWriteHook
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to execute code after writing traceback but before UI.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs this handler as the global Python exception hook.

methods.name: openFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary file for dumping exception info.

methods.name: runQuit
methods.description: Quits the program; can be overridden.

methods.name: runDebug
methods.description: Enters debugger on exception; can be overridden.

methods.name: runShell
methods.description: Opens a shell for debugging; can be overridden.

methods.name: runSave
methods.description: Saves exception info to a report; can be overridden.
